==Name rerolling==
In the Stats menu the miner's name can rerolled. Rerolling the name has a 1 in 8 chance to add on a surname. Certain names come with a special rare Easter Egg Skin which, if claimed, remain permanently available in the Skins menu. It is also possible to roll a name from a List which includes some community members and memes. A free reroll is earned every time you prestige, and rerolls can also be purchased for {{Gems|5}} each.

==Body Type==
The miner's Body Type can either be A or B. By default Body Type <code>Any</code> is selected, which means if the miner's name has the letter Y in it, Body Type B applies. Otherwise, Body Type A appears. Body Type <code>A</code> or Body Type <code>B</code> can also be selected to manually choose a Body Type. Body Type rules don't apply to Easter Egg skins.

==Easter Egg Skins== 
You get these skins by rolling the name. If you claim the name, you permanently unlock the option to change back to the skin. They don't count for rewards. There is a 1 in 10k chance to get an Easter Egg Skin. There is no duplicate protection. Easter Egg rolls are not affected by body type selection.
